title: Light Crispy Tunisian Jalapeno Flatbread
description: A peppery and crispy Tunisian dish featuring jalapeno, shio-cure, and plant-based friendly ingredients, perfect for a snack or light meal. This flatbread is infused with the flavors of North Africa and the spicy kick of jalapeno.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, shio-cure, salt, sugar, and yeast.
Gradually add the warm water to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Brush the dough with olive oil and top with sliced jalapeno peppers.
Cook the flatbread for 2-3 minutes on each side, until it is crispy and golden brown.
